page_title: NIC 0-0 MON | Nice v Monaco 08/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+5' Ali Abdi (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Nice are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Monaco exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
90+2' The linesman signals that Elye Wahi (Nice) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Charles Vanhoutte is replaced by Everton Pereira (Nice).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Elye Wahi (Nice).
88' Vanderson (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
87' Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
85' Elye Wahi (Nice) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
84' Substitution. Sofiane Diop will be replaced by Isak Jansson (Nice).
84' Morgan Sanson is substituted due to injury. Claude Puel gives a chance to Juma Bah (Nice).
83' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' He should have scored! Elye Wahi (Nice) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Philipp Kohn makes an easy save.
79' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies miles over the crossbar. Very poor shot.
78' The total number of attempts is 10:9.
76' Sebastien Pocognoli prepares a substitution. Krepin Diatta is replaced by Vanderson (Monaco).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Simon Adingra as he is replaced by Mika Biereth (Monaco).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) is coming onto the pitch as Aladji Bamba cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Sofiane Diop (Nice) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
71' Elye Wahi (Nice) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Philipp Kohn is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
69' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to send the ball in.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Monaco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Here's the change. Aleksandr Golovin leaves the pitch and Caio Henrique (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.
64' Claude Puel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) replacing Tom Louchet.
64' Substitution. Gabin Bernardeau makes his way off the pitch and Kail Boudache (Nice) comes on as his replacement.
63' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
61' Benoit Bastien blows for a foul after Sofiane Diop (Nice) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
59' Nice are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
57' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
55' Simon Adingra (Monaco) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
55' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is cleared to safety by the defence.
54' Lamine Camara (Monaco) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Lamine Camara (Monaco) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
51' Monaco hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
49' Morgan Sanson (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

47' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) collects the ball on the edge of the box and produces a precise shot which would have ended in the bottom left corner, if Maxime Dupe hadn't pulled off a wonderful save.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
41' A quickly taken corner by Nice.
39' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Gabin Bernardeau (Nice) sends it out of play.
37' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:3.
33' What a huge chance for Sofiane Diop (Nice). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
32' The resulting corner from Lamine Camara (Monaco) is cleared by the defence.

32' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Monaco.
30' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation.
29' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Simon Adingra (Monaco).
27' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
25' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
23' Monaco are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
20' Aladji Bamba (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
18' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Sofiane Diop (Nice) for his blatant foul.
16' Ali Abdi (Nice) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post.
15' 50:50 – the latest ball possession ratio.
13' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
12' Morgan Sanson (Nice) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

10' Dante (Nice) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
10' Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Nice is cautioned for aggressive play.
8' Some patient build-up play from Nice as they look to unlock the defence.
6' The Nice players can’t believe it after referee Benoit Bastien signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
5' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nice players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Benoit Bastien interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
3' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nice will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
